# Choro modifications

- Upstream: <https://github.com/manyougz/velotype>
- Baseline: version/tag 0.6.0, commit `7802fb1d02fae12cf95f5308a3568a27cdcefa32`
- Upstream license: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-APACHE`)

Choro embeds Velotype as a library and carries changes for editor commands,
references, native HTML and image handling, syntax highlighting, source mapping,
selection behavior, configuration, and integration tests. Modified and
Choro-added Rust files carry a prominent notice pointing to this record.
